source_anomaly_disclosure: No internal inconsistencies detected - the archive closes against its own definitions: HI = S2/TOC x 100 re-derives on ALL 9 rows within 0.47 units of the archived integers, and the transformation ratio S1/(S1+S2) re-derives on all 7 populated rows within 0.005; noted for the record: TR and Tmax are BLANK on exactly the same two rows (the two lowest-S2 samples, 0.75 and 0.24 mg/g, where the S2 peak is too small for a reliable Tmax) although TR is arithmetically computable there - the archive's own quality judgment, preserved as blanks
purpose: forty-third catalogue entry - the WOODLARK BASIN / SOLOMON SEA joins as region THIRTY-ONE (the type locality of active low-angle-normal-fault rifting) and ROCK-EVAL PYROLYSIS is kind THIRTY-TWO: the petroleum-systems screening quantity itself, the first source-rock assessment data in an energy-industry catalogue - and the verdict re-derives as arithmetic on every gate run: SPECTACULAR RICHNESS WITHOUT MATURITY - TOC to 32.86 pct and S2 to 86.92 mg/g (genuine source potential in the Miocene coaly interval), yet every measured Tmax sits at 397-424 C, below the ~435 C oil-window threshold (thermally immature), with 8 of 9 samples at HI < 160 (gas-prone Type III/IV terrestrial organic matter) - a source rock that has everything except time and temperature
